1519.reportZh: 本基金於8月份錄得1.55%回報。主要貢獻來自全球股票策略。受到穩健的經濟增長和另一波強勁的企業盈利支持，富時強積金全球股票指數在8月份反彈2.8%。美國股市在可觀的企業利潤推動下回升，而全球公司盈利的預期則持續改善。富時強積金世界政府債券指數（100%港元對沖）在8月微跌了0.1%。由於美國聯邦儲備局主席沃什在全球央行年會上發出了鷹派信號，債券投資者保持謹慎。雖然美國財政部擴大債券回購計劃，為市場提供了短暫的緩解，但長期債券利率上升，反映出全球債券市場持續的擔憂。
1519.reportEn: The fund recorded 1.55% return in August. The main contributors were global equities. The FTSE MPF All World Index rebounded and gained 2.8% in August, supported by resilient economic growth and another strong corporate earnings season. United States’ equity markets recovered on the back of upbeat corporate profits, while global earnings expectations continued to improve. The FTSE MPF World Government Bond Index (100% Hedged to Hong Kong Dollar) was mildly down by 0.1% in August. Bond investors stayed cautious as Federal Reserve chairman Kevin Warsh sent hawkish signal at the Jackson Hole symposium. While the United States Treasury’s expanded bond buyback programme provided temporary relief to the market, long-term yields resumed their upward trend, reflecting ongoing concerns in global bond markets.

878.reportZh: 本基金於8月份錄得2.58%回報。主要貢獻來自能源和資訊科技產業。道瓊工業平均指數於8月上升了1.3%，但表現不如以科技股主導的納斯達克綜合指數，後者同月上漲3.9%。科技和能源行業帶動了盈利增長，並顯示盈利增長正在向其它行業漫延。以軟件和半導體公司為主的科技股，在7月的拋售潮後重新獲得投資者關注。美國經濟仍然相對活躍，但高頻經濟數據表現參差。採購經理指數仍處於擴張區間，但消費者信心指標較上個月有所下降。
878.reportEn: The fund recorded 2.58% return in August. The main contributors were the Energy and Information Technology sectors. In August, the Dow Jones Industrial Average gained 1.3% but underperformed the tech-heavy Nasdaq Composite Index which jumped 3.9%. Technology and Energy sectors led earnings growth, with signs that earnings strength is broadening across industries. Technology shares regained momentum after July’s sell-off, led by software and semiconductor companies. Economic activity in the United States remained relatively healthy but high frequency economic statistics were mixed. The purchasing managers’ indices stayed firmly in expansion territory, but consumer sentiment indicators declined from their previous month’s levels.

876.reportZh: 本基金於8月份錄得2.73%回報。主要貢獻來自亞太區股票策略。富時強積金亞太（除日本外）指數8月以港幣計價上升3.7%。以科技股主導的韓國綜合股價指數在前1個月暴跌22.2%之後，於8月份反彈了3.4%。這次回升主要是由建築、化工和機械行業推動。在人工智能相關科技股強勁反彈的推動下，台灣證券交易所加權指數在8月飆升了7%。該島的工業生產和出口在7月錄得連續18個月的雙位數年度增長。歐洲斯托克指數在8月小幅上升0.8%，德國DAX指數和法國CAC指數都創下歷史新高。歐元區8月綜合採購經理指數初值上升至52.1，是9個月以來的最高水平。商業活動的改善主要是由製造業生產回升所帶動。
876.reportEn: The fund recorded 2.73% return in August. The main contributors were Asia Pacific equities. The FTSE MPF Asia Pacific ex Japan Index was up by 3.7% in August in HKD term. The tech-heavy Korea Composite Stock Price Index recovered 3.4% in August after losing 22.2% a month ago. The rebound was mainly contributed by construction, chemicals and machinery sectors. Strong rebound in Artificial Intelligence-related technology stocks caused the Taiwan Stock Exchange Weighted Index to jump by 7% in August. The island’s industrial production and export sector registered double-digit yearly growth for eighteen consecutive months in July. The Euro Stoxx Index was mildly up by 0.8% in August with both the DAX and the CAC hitting record highs. Eurozone preliminary composite purchasing managers’ index for the month of August rose to a nine-month high of 52.1. The improvement in business activity was mainly contributed by pickup in manufacturing production.

Insurers also faced selling pressure as China imposed full look-through tax on households’ cross-border investment in offshore trusts and insurance. The Hang Seng China Enterprises Index lost 1.1% in August.

658.reportZh: 本基金於8月份錄得2.60%回報。主要貢獻來自亞太區股票策略。受到穩健的經濟增長和另一波強勁的企業盈利支持，富時強積金全球股票指數在8月份反彈2.8%。美國股市在可觀的企業利潤推動下回升，而全球公司盈利的預期則持續改善。儘管中東地緣政治局勢仍然緊張，以及市場的利率預期在全球央行年會的鷹派言論後上升，投資者依然保持積極的情緒。全球經濟活動的增長升至自中東軍事衝突爆發以來最快的速度。7月份摩根大通全球綜合採購經理指數初值上升至52.6，為5個月以來的最高水平。富時強積金亞太（除日本外）指數8月以港幣計價上升3.7%。以科技股主導的韓國綜合股價指數在前1個月暴跌22.2%之後，於8月份反彈了3.4%。這次回升主要是由建築、化工和機械行業推動。在人工智能相關科技股強勁反彈的推動下，台灣證券交易所加權指數在8月飆升了7%。該島的工業生產和出口在7月錄得連續18個月的雙位數年度增長。
658.reportEn: The fund recorded 2.60% return in August. The main contributors were Asia Pacific equities. The FTSE MPF All World Index rebounded and gained 2.8% in August, supported by resilient economic growth and another strong corporate earnings season. United States’ equity markets recovered on the back of upbeat corporate profits, while global earnings expectations continued to improve. Despite ongoing geopolitical tensions in the Middle East and higher interest rate expectations following a hawkish Jackson Hole speech, investor sentiment remained constructive. Global economic momentum grew at its quickest rate since the outbreak of military conflict in the Middle East. The preliminary JPMorgan Global Composite Purchasing Managers’ Index for the month of July rose to 52.6, the highest level in five months. The FTSE MPF Asia Pacific ex Japan Index was up by 3.7% in August in HKD term. The tech-heavy Korea Composite Stock Price Index recovered 3.4% in August after losing 22.2% a month ago. The rebound was mainly contributed by Construction, Chemicals and Machinery sectors. Strong rebound in Artificial Intelligence-related technology stocks caused the Taiwan Stock Exchange Weighted Index to jump by 7% in August. The island’s industrial production and export sector registered double-digit yearly growth for eighteen consecutive months in July.

875.reportZh: 本基金於8月份錄得0.33%回報。基金表現主要由於利息收入推動。本月，由於聯儲局立場偏鷹，令市場加息預期升溫，導致美國國債收益率曲線變平，而長端利率趨於穩定。在亞洲美元信貸方面，信用利差有所收窄。進入9月，由於地緣政治局勢維持緊張，當前宏觀經濟狀況和美國總統特朗普政策的不確定性，可能會改變市場對美國貨幣政策決策的預期，美國國債收益率因此會持續波動。因此，中長期優質亞洲美元債券仍然是投資重點，以獲得具吸引力的回報，同時亦減少利率波動對價格的負面影響。
875.reportEn: The fund recorded 0.33% return in August. Performance was driven mainly by interest income. The US Treasury yield curve flattened given the Fed’s hawkish stance boosting rate hike expectations, while stabilizing long-end rates. Asian Dollar credits spreads tightened during the month. Going into September, US Treasury bond yields may continue to stay volatile amid ongoing geopolitical tensions, current macroeconomic conditions and uncertainties regarding US President Trump’s policies, which influence market expectations on the US monetary decisions. As such, medium to long term high-quality Asian USD bonds continue to be the investment focus for attractive return while minimising the negative price impact from interest rates fluctuations.

657.reportZh: 本基金於8月份錄得0.24%回報。富時強積金世界政府債券指數（35%港元對沖）8月份錄得上升。基金表現主要由於利息收入推動。中東地緣政治緊張局勢持續，布蘭特原油價格徘徊在每桶約90美元。美國國債利率整體維持穩定，但孳息曲線趨於平坦。此前聯儲局主席沃什在在全球央行年會上發表鷹派信號，促使市場預期政策將進一步收緊。歐洲方面，經濟活動維持韌性，得益於德國和法國以外地區的強勁增長，歐元區8月綜合採購經理人指數初值錄得52.1。就業和新訂單情況有所改善，同時價格壓力整體持續緩解。在日本，受財政政策趨於寬鬆及通脹壓力重燃的影響，10年期政府債券利率上升至2.95%。8月底，10年期美國國債利率為4.75%（與7月底的4.74%基本持平）。10年期德國國債利率為3.32%（較7月底的3.20%有所上升）。
657.reportEn: The fund recorded 0.24% return in August. The FTSE MPF World Government Bond Index (35% HKD Hedged) posted a positive return in August. Performance was driven mainly by interest income. Geopolitical tensions in the Middle East remained elevated, with Brent crude hovering around US$90 per barrel. US Treasury yields were broadly stable, although the yield curve flattened as markets priced in greater policy tightening following hawkish remarks from Federal Reserve Chair Warsh at Jackson Hole. In Europe, economic activity remained resilient, with the Eurozone flash composite PMI at 52.1 in August, supported by stronger growth outside Germany and France. Employment and new orders improved, while price pressures generally continued to ease. In Japan, the 10-year government bond yield climbed to 2.95% amid the looser fiscal backdrop and renewed inflationary pressures. 10-year US Treasuries ended August at 4.75% (in-line with 4.74% at July-end). 10-year German Bunds at 3.32% (up from 3.20%).

134.reportZh: 本基金於8月份錄得0.17%回報。本月，港元短期利率整體上升，由於股票集資活動增加，短端因資金狀況有所收緊而上升；長端則保持相對穩定。進入9月，除了基於本地的資金情況外，地緣政治局勢持續緊張，當前宏觀經濟狀況變化和美國政策的不確定性可能會繼續改變市場對美國貨幣政策決策的預期，亦會影響香港短期利率的走勢。
134.reportEn: The fund recorded 0.17% return in August. HKD short term rates moved upwards broadly, with shorter end rising higher due to tightened funding condition given increased equity fundraising activities, while longer end remained relatively stable. Going into September, in addition to the domestic funding condition, the elevated rate fluctuations driven by ongoing geopolitical tensions, evolving global macroeconomic conditions and uncertainties surrounding US policies, which may continue to shape market expectations on the US monetary decisions and impact HKD short term rates.

1579.reportZh: 本基金於8月份錄得-0.04%回報。主要拖累來自於香港股票策略。恒生指數在8月份下跌1.2%。聯邦儲備局主席在全球央行年會發表的鷹派言論引發了市場對利率進一步上升的擔憂，導致地產分類指數下跌4.1%。保險股也面臨拋售壓力，因為中國政府對居民跨境投資離岸信託和保險產品實施了全面穿透式課稅。恒生中國企業指數在8月份下跌了1.1%。在8月，滬深300指數小幅上升0.8%。全球對人工智能相關硬體的強勁需求，推動資訊科技分類指數上漲6.6%。然而，受國內需求疲弱拖累，消費相關行業表現相對落後。7月份零售銷售年度增速從上個月的1.0%放緩至0.6%。中國經濟仍呈現不均衡的增長。雖然國內需求依舊疲弱，但在海外對高端科技製造產品的強勁需求帶動下，7月出口按年增長23.9%。本月，香港政府港元債券收益率曲線就加息預期升溫而上行。就港元信貸而言，信用利差稍微擴闊。踏入9月，在地緣政治局勢維持緊張、全球宏觀經濟發展以及美國政策不確定性的影響下，市場對美國貨幣政策決策的預期不斷改變，港元債券收益率料將持續波動。同時，本港經濟情況及投資於股票或避險資產的港元資金流向亦會影響港元債券收益率。因此，中長期優質港元債券仍然是投資重點，以獲得具吸引力的回報，同時亦能減少利率波動對價格的負面影響。
1579.reportEn: The fund recorded -0.04% return in August. The main detractors were the Hong Kong equities. The Hang Seng Index was down by 1.2% in August. Federal Reserve chairman’s hawkish comment at Jackson Hole raised concerns about further rise in interest rates, sending the property sub-index down by 4.1%. Insurers also faced selling pressure as China imposed full look-through tax on households’ cross-border investment in offshore trusts and insurance. The Hang Seng China Enterprises Index lost 1.1% in August. The CSI 300 Index went mildly up by 0.8% in August. Strong global demand for Artificial Intelligence-related hardware helped boost the performance of Information Technology sub-index which gained 6.6%. However, Consumption-related sectors were dragged down by weak domestic demand. In July, the yearly growth of retail sales decelerated to 0.6% from 1.0% a month ago. Chinese economy is still on an uneven growth trajectory. Although domestic demand remained weak, export expanded by 23.9% year-on-year in July thanks to robust demand for sophisticated high-tech manufacturing products. Hong Kong government HKD bond yield curve shifted upwards in August, due to increased rate hike expectations. In terms of HKD credits, spreads widened slightly during the month. Going into September, HKD bond yields are expected to remain volatile amid ongoing geopolitical tensions, global macroeconomic development and US policies uncertainties, which influence market expectations on the US monetary decisions. Meanwhile, Hong Kong domestic economic conditions and HKD fund flows for equity investments or pursuit of haven assets also influence HKD bond yields. As such, medium to long term high-quality HKD bonds continue to be the investment focus for attractive return while minimising the negative price impact from interest rates fluctuations.

699.reportZh: 本基金於8月份錄得3.41%回報。主要貢獻來自亞太區股票策略。受到穩健的經濟增長和另一波強勁的企業盈利支持，富時強積金全球股票指數在8月份反彈2.8%。美國股市在可觀的企業利潤推動下回升，而全球公司盈利的預期則持續改善。儘管中東地緣政治局勢仍然緊張，以及市場的利率預期在全球央行年會的鷹派言論後上升，投資者依然保持積極的情緒。全球經濟活動的增長升至自中東軍事衝突爆發以來最快的速度。7月份摩根大通全球綜合採購經理指數初值上升至52.6，為5個月以來的最高水平。富時強積金亞太（除日本外）指數8月以港幣計價上升3.7%。以科技股主導的韓國綜合股價指數在前1個月暴跌22.2%之後，於8月份反彈了3.4%。這次回升主要是由建築、化工和機械行業推動。在人工智能相關科技股強勁反彈的推動下，台灣證券交易所加權指數在8月飆升了7%。該島的工業生產和出口在7月錄得連續18個月的雙位數年度增長。富時強積金世界政府債券指數（35%港元對沖）在8月微跌升了0.2%。由於美國聯邦儲備局主席沃什在全球央行年會上發出了鷹派信號，債券投資者保持謹慎。雖然美國財政部擴大債券回購計劃，為市場提供了短暫的緩解，但長期債券利率上升，反映出全球債券市場持續的擔憂。美國十年期國債息率在7月首次自2025年初以來突破4.7%後，該收益率於8月份繼續徘徊在這一水平。在投資者擔憂通脹居高不下、政府財政赤字不斷擴大和借貸需求持續增加的背景下，要求更高的長期政府債券回報，導致全球債券收益率持續攀升。
699.reportEn: The fund recorded 3.41% return in August. The main contributors were Asia Pacific equities. The FTSE MPF All World Index rebounded and gained 2.8% in August, supported by resilient economic growth and another strong corporate earnings season. United States’ equity markets recovered on the back of upbeat corporate profits, while global earnings expectations continued to improve. Despite ongoing geopolitical tensions in the Middle East and higher interest rate expectations following a hawkish Jackson Hole speech, investor sentiment remained constructive. Global economic momentum grew at its quickest rate since the outbreak of military conflict in the Middle East. The preliminary JPMorgan Global Composite Purchasing Managers’ Index for the month of July rose to 52.6, the highest level in five months. The FTSE MPF Asia Pacific ex Japan Index was up by 3.7% in August in HKD term. The tech-heavy Korea Composite Stock Price Index recovered 3.4% in August after losing 22.2% a month ago. The rebound was mainly contributed by Construction, Chemicals and Machinery sectors. Strong rebound in Artificial Intelligence-related technology stocks caused the Taiwan Stock Exchange Weighted Index to jump by 7% in August. The island’s industrial production and export sector registered double-digit yearly growth for eighteen consecutive months in July. After rising above 4.7% for the first time since early 2025 in July, the 10-year United States Treasury yield hovered around this level in August. Global bond yields continued to climb as investors demanded higher compensation for holding long-term government debts amid persistent inflation concerns, widening fiscal deficits, and increased borrowing needs.

137.reportEn: The fund recorded 4.10% return in August. The main detractors were the Hong Kong equities. The Hang Seng Index was down by 1.2% in August. Federal Reserve chairman’s hawkish comment at Jackson Hole raised concerns about further rise in interest rates, sending the property sub-index down by 4.1%. Insurers also faced selling pressure as China imposed full look-through tax on households’ cross-border investment in offshore trusts and insurance. The Hang Seng China Enterprises Index lost 1.1% in August. The CSI 300 Index went mildly up by 0.8% in August. Strong global demand for Artificial Intelligence- related hardware helped boost the performance of Information Technology sub-index which gained 6.6%. However, Consumption-related sectors were dragged down by weak domestic demand. In July, the yearly growth of retail sales decelerated to 0.6% from 1.0% a month ago. Chinese economy is still on an uneven growth trajectory. Although domestic demand remained weak, export expanded by 23.9% year-on-year in July thanks to robust demand for sophisticated high-tech manufacturing products. Strong rebound in Artificial Intelligence-related technology stocks caused the Taiwan Stock Exchange Weighted Index to jump by 7% in August. The island’s industrial production and export sector registered double-digit yearly growth for eighteen consecutive months in July. The tech-heavy Korea Composite Stock Price Index recovered 3.4% in August after losing 22.2% a month ago. The rebound was mainly contributed by Construction, Chemicals and Machinery sectors.

142.reportZh: 本基金於8月份錄得2.81%回報。主要貢獻來自資訊科技產業。道瓊工業平均指數於8月上升了1.3%，但表現不如以科技股主導的納斯達克綜合指數，後者同月上漲3.9%。科技和能源行業帶動了盈利增長，並顯示盈利增長正在向其它行業漫延。以軟件和半導體公司為主的科技股，在7月的拋售潮後重新獲得投資者關注。美國經濟仍然相對活躍，但高頻經濟數據表現參差。採購經理指數仍處於擴張區間，但消費者信心指標較上個月有所下降。美國股票市場前景維持審慎樂觀，受到經濟增長具韌性及企業盈利穩健的支持，儘管宏觀不確定性仍然存在。2026年第二季的財報季表現格外強勁，標普500指數成分股的獲利超預期幅度接近29%，創下歷史新高。市場增長持續主要由大盤科技股及人工智能（AI）相關的資本支出所驅動，同時能源和製造業也呈現強勁復甦態勢。
142.reportEn: The fund recorded 2.81% return in August. The main contributor was the Information Technology sector. In August, the Dow Jones Industrial Average gained 1.3% but underperformed the tech-heavy Nasdaq Composite Index which jumped 3.9%. Technology and energy sectors led earnings growth, with signs that earnings strength is broadening across industries. Technology shares regained momentum after July’s sell-off, led by software and semiconductor companies. Economic activity in the United States remained relatively healthy but high frequency economic statistics were mixed. The purchasing managers’ indices stayed firmly in expansion territory, but consumer sentiment indicators declined from their previous month’s levels. The US equity market outlook remains cautiously constructive, supported by resilient economic growth and solid corporate earnings, despite lingering macro uncertainties. Q2 2026 earnings season has delivered exceptionally robust results, tracking record-high earnings surprises near 29% for the S&P 500. Growth continues to be heavily driven by large-cap Technology and AI-related capital expenditures, alongside strong rebounds in energy and manufacturing sectors.

141.reportZh: 本基金於8月份錄得3.48%回報。就國家而言，美國是帶動投資組合表現的主要因素，相反法國則拖累組合表現。就行業而言，資訊科技帶動相對回報，而工業則拖累表現。投資團隊繼續降低對美國市場的配置，以減低集中度及估值風險。歐洲在盈利增長，以及推動戰略自主方面均具吸引力。日本方面，憑藉穩健的盈利能力、股份回購、偏向增長的政策，以及顯著的企業管治改革，投資團隊正發掘投資機會。投資團隊對新興市場維持正面看法，同時亦留意人工智能資本開支動能對股市指數表現的重要性。
141.reportEn: The fund recorded 3.48% return in August.   At the country level, the United States was the key contributor, while France detracted. At the sector level, Information Technology added to the relative return, while Industrials detracted.  Investment team continue to diversify away from the US to reduce concentration and valuation risks. Europe looks attractive on earnings growth and the drive toward strategic autonomy. In Japan, investment team are finding opportunities given robust profitability, share buybacks, pro-growth policies and notable governance reforms. Investment team remain constructive on Emerging Market, while noting the importance of AI capex momentum for equity indices.

146.reportZh: 本基金於8月份錄得0.13%回報。本月，香港政府港元債券收益率曲線就加息預期升溫而上行。就港元信貸而言，信用利差稍微擴闊。踏入9月，在地緣政治局勢維持緊張、全球宏觀經濟發展以及美國政策不確定性的影響下，市場對美國貨幣政策決策的預期不斷改變，港元債券收益率料將持續波動。同時，本港經濟情況及投資於股票或避險資產的港元資金流向亦會影響港元債券收益率。因此，中長期優質港元債券仍然是投資重點，以獲得具吸引力的回報，同時亦能減少利率波動對價格的負面影響。
146.reportEn: The fund recorded 0.13% return in August. Hong Kong government HKD bond yield curve shifted upwards in August, due to increased rate hike expectations. In terms of HKD credits, spreads widened slightly during the month. Going into September, HKD bond yields are expected to remain volatile amid ongoing geopolitical tensions, global macroeconomic development and US policies uncertainties, which influence market expectations on the US monetary decisions. Meanwhile, Hong Kong domestic economic conditions and HKD fund flows for equity investments or pursuit of haven assets also influence HKD bond yields. As such, medium to long term high-quality HKD bonds continue to be the investment focus for attractive return while minimising the negative price impact from interest rates fluctuations.

132.reportZh: 本基金於8月份錄得1.51%回報。主要貢獻來自亞太區股票策略。受到穩健的經濟增長和另一波強勁的企業盈利支持，富時強積金全球股票指數在8月份反彈2.8%。美國股市在可觀的企業利潤推動下回升，而全球公司盈利的預期則持續改善。儘管中東地緣政治局勢仍然緊張，以及市場的利率預期在全球央行年會的鷹派言論後上升，投資者依然保持積極的情緒。全球經濟活動的增長升至自中東軍事衝突爆發以來最快的速度。7月份摩根大通全球綜合採購經理指數初值上升至52.6，為5個月以來的最高水平。富時強積金亞太（除日本外）指數8月以港幣計價上升3.7%。以科技股主導的韓國綜合股價指數在前1個月暴跌22.2%之後，於8月份反彈了3.4%。這次回升主要是由建築、化工和機械行業推動。在人工智能相關科技股強勁反彈的推動下，台灣證券交易所加權指數在8月飆升了7%。該島的工業生產和出口在7月錄得連續18個月的雙位數年度增長。富時強積金世界政府債券指數（35%港元對沖）在8月微跌升了0.2%。由於美國聯邦儲備局主席沃什在全球央行年會上發出了鷹派信號，債券投資者保持謹慎。雖然美國財政部擴大債券回購計劃，為市場提供了短暫的緩解，但長期債券利率上升，反映出全球債券市場持續的擔憂。美國十年期國債息率在7月首次自2025年初以來突破4.7%後，該收益率於8月份繼續徘徊在這一水平。在投資者擔憂通脹居高不下、政府財政赤字不斷擴大和借貸需求持續增加的背景下，要求更高的長期政府債券回報，導致全球債券收益率持續攀升。
132.reportEn: The fund recorded 1.51% return in August. The main contributors were Asia Pacific equities. The FTSE MPF All World Index rebounded and gained 2.8% in August, supported by resilient economic growth and another strong corporate earnings season. United States’ equity markets recovered on the back of upbeat corporate profits, while global earnings expectations continued to improve. Despite ongoing geopolitical tensions in the Middle East and higher interest rate expectations following a hawkish Jackson Hole speech, investor sentiment remained constructive. Global economic momentum grew at its quickest rate since the outbreak of military conflict in the Middle East. The preliminary JPMorgan Global Composite Purchasing Managers’ Index for the month of July rose to 52.6, the highest level in five months. The FTSE MPF Asia Pacific ex Japan Index was up by 3.7% in August in HKD term. The tech-heavy Korea Composite Stock Price Index recovered 3.4% in August after losing 22.2% a month ago. The rebound was mainly contributed by Construction, Chemicals and Machinery sectors. Strong rebound in Artificial Intelligence-related technology stocks caused the Taiwan Stock Exchange Weighted Index to jump by 7% in August. The island’s Industrial Production and Export sector registered double-digit yearly growth for eighteen consecutive months in July. The FTSE MPF World Government Bond Index (35% HKD Hedged) was mildly up by 0.2% in August. Bond investors stayed cautious as Federal Reserve chairman Kevin Warsh sent hawkish signal at the Jackson Hole symposium. While the United States Treasury’s expanded bond buyback programme provided temporary relief to the market, long-term yields resumed their upward trend, reflecting ongoing concerns in global bond markets. After rising above 4.7% for the first time since early 2025 in July, the 10-year United States Treasury yield hovered around this level in August. Global bond yields continued to climb as investors demanded higher compensation for holding long-term government debts amid persistent inflation concerns, widening fiscal deficits, and increased borrowing needs.
